current.author: model
current.text:
Dear Hiring team at Monzo,

I am applying for the Senior Product Manager, Payments role. My background is in payments platforms at regulated fintechs, where I owned the roadmap for card and bank-transfer rails and led a team of six.

Two things in the posting stood out. The emphasis on reconciliation matches work I have shipped end to end, and the scope of platform ownership is the part of the job I have most enjoyed in the past.

I would welcome the chance to talk it through.
current.subject: Application: Senior Product Manager, Payments
